message: In the concealed under-deck support frame (C2), the bolted cross-frame connection for the added mass has needed final quantified closure, Manager. To check it I used hand calculation with static plus dynamic summation reusing the repeated check calculation (E10) with stiffness from the optimal Tuned Mass Damper (TMD) sizing (E4). I found 3924 Newtons static and 4373 Newtons peak per 400 kilogram unit giving about 7 Megapascals per Metric 16 millimetre bolt (M16) group, according to Eurocode 3, 2005. I propose retaining four preloaded Metric 16 millimetre bolt (M16) per module on galvanized cross-frames with lockable hatches accessed from below. My position: ready because connection load and fatigue margin are closed with Structural Dynamics Lead. In the deck-view preservation detail (C2), the deck surface and parapet line has needed proof of zero visual change, Structural Dynamics Lead. To check it I used visibility review reusing the concealed mounting cross-section (E7) with clearance from the controlled-response stroke estimate (E6). I found zero change above deck with all hardware below soffit and 8.2 millimetres stroke within 30 millimetres clearance, according to French Assessment Service for Roads and Motorways (Setra), 2006. I propose soffit-matched finish with no penetration of wearing surface. My position: ready because under-deck geometry and finishes preserve deck appearance.
